high_level_description: 1600x900 landscape SVG draft highlighting precise physical interactions: left-side hose/water/bike/fence; right-side dog-oak, cat-truck, ladybug-chain-to-ball, and overhead drone — all on sparse white background

style_description.aesthetics: clean structural diagram, schematic yet purposeful

compositional_deconstruction.background: plain white background, no textures or gradients

elements.desc: woman bending leftward: beige head circle, tan torso ellipse, bent arm line, red hand circle at hose nozzle
red rectangular hose nozzle, held by woman's hand
light blue curved water arc, smooth parabolic path from nozzle upward and right
black bicycle: two wheels (circles), frame (angled lines), leaning rightward
short brown fence segment: three vertical posts and one horizontal rail
brown terrier digging at base of oak trunk, front paws raised, soil implied by angled lines below
vertical brown oak trunk, thick rectangle extending from ground to low branch
gray cat sitting on blue pickup truck hood, paws clearly placed on surface
blue pickup truck: trapezoidal bed + rectangular cab, positioned horizontally
red tennis ball, resting on ground near truck rear
ladybug chain: 7 alternating red/black circles (12px diameter) connected by thin black lines, starting at oak branch (y~340) and arcing toward tennis ball
small gray drone: central square with four outward L-shaped rotors, hovering above right zone
